notes.title: 🐣 Thank You + Upcoming Fixes(Full Controller Support, Bug Fixes etc) 🛠️
notes.content:
Thank you all for making Easter in Thrae so special! We've loved seeing your screenshots, feedback, and all the cozy vibes you’ve brought to the forest.

As we move forward, we wanted to acknowledge a few things we’re currently working on behind the scenes:

 🎮 Controller Support – We currently have only Partial Controller support(Movement and Jumping) and in the next big update we will be looking to make it possible to play all of Thrae with a controller.

 🐸 Pathing Concerns  – We’re aware some of you have had some navigation oddities, especially in the swamp, and will be addressing these soon.

 ✏️ Spelling MIstakes & UI Polish – There is a lot of Dialogue in Thrae, so naturally some issues can occur. Minor typos and UI oddities are being cleaned up to keep the experience feeling tidy and immersive. 

🎵 Music – We are planning to add more music to the game.  

🌿 Save File Issues – We’ve seen the reports and are working on improving stability and reliability.

Thank you for your continued support, patience, and kindness as we continue to shape Thrae into something truly magical. More updates soon!

With gratitude,
— The Thrae Team

notes.title: 🎉🌸 Thrae is OUT NOW! 🌸🎉 Happy Easter!
notes.content:
🌿🐰 Thrae is finally here 🐰🌿

To our wonderful community,

Happy Easter! We have been dreaming, building, and pouring our hearts into this little world, Thrae is finally ready to be shared with you. Today, we’re proud (and honestly a little emotional) to say.... 
🎉🌸 Thrae is OUT NOW! 🌸🎉

At its core, Thrae is a story about kindness, about helping others when times are tough, and about finding beauty in the quiet moments. 

We made Thrae for anyone who needed a peaceful place to explore, to laugh, to rest, and to reconnect with nature, with others, and with themselves.

🌷 From our forest to yours, thank you for playing. We hope you feel the love we put into every corner of Thrae.

Come join our discord community to join the discussion: https://discord.gg/4uq4JJDpAe

notes.title: 🎉🐰 Thrae Arrives April 18th, 2025! 🐰🎉
notes.content:
The wait is almost over! We’re thrilled to announce that Thrae will officially launch on April 18th, 2025—just in time for Easter! 🌸✨

Step into the paws of a young bunny on a heartwarming journey to become the The Easter Bunny, crafting magical eggs, exploring a world full of puzzles, fishing, and helping woodland creatures prepare for winter. But beware the mysterious Thrae Hunters lurk in the shadows…

🌿 Cozy open-world exploration
🥚 Egg crafting & heartwarming NPC relationships
🚣‍♀️ Fishing, mini games and movement puzzles
🐾 A world full of secrets waiting to be discovered

We can’t wait for you to experience Thrae! Mark your calendars, wishlist the game, and stay tuned for more updates as we hop closer to launch! 💛

notes.title: What’s Next for Thrae? 🐰✨
notes.content:
Hey everyone! First off, a huge thank you to everyone who checked out Thrae during Next Fest! Your support, feedback, and excitement means the world to us. 💛 
Next Fest was a huge milestone for us, bringing in hundreds of new players and leading to the creation of thousands of eggs!

Now, let’s talk about what’s next! Here’s what we’re working on:

🔹 Deeper NPC Relationships – The three-level relationship system is coming! The more you help NPCs, the more they’ll trust you, unlocking new rewards, recipes, and special moments.

🔹 Cave Exploration – Mysterious hidden caves are being added, filled with puzzles, rare crafting materials, and maybe even a few secrets… 👀

🔹 More Egg Customization – We’re expanding the egg-making system with new colors, patterns, and effects so you can truly personalize your gifts for the forest!

🔹 Optimization & Polish – Smoother controls, better performance, and tweaks based on your feedback to make Thrae as cozy and immersive as possible.

🛠️ Want to Playtest? Join the Discord!
We’ll be running exclusive playtests soon, and we want your feedback! Join our Discord community to help shape Thrae and get an early look at what’s coming!

💬[url=https://discord.gg/4uq4JJDpAe]Join the Discord here![/url]

Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks again for being part of this journey! 🌿🐣

notes.title: 🎉 Thrae Next Fest Demo – Now Live! 🐰✨
notes.content:
The wait is over! The Next Fest Demo for Thrae is live! 🌿🐣  Step into a world where the energy that flows through all of us connects creatures great and small. notes.title: 🐰🌸 A Special Announcement from the World of THRAE! 🌸🐰
notes.content:

Hello World,

We’ve been pouring our hearts into the game, and now, we’re beyond excited to finally share it with you—THRAE is officially coming to life! ✨

Easter has always been a time of wonder, renewal, and joy, and we wanted to capture that magic in a whole new way. THRAE is our love letter to the season—a world where the Easter Bunny’s journey isn’t just about delivering eggs, but about building bonds, spreading hope, and making every connection matter.

And today, we’re revealing the very first announcement trailer! 🎥💖

We can’t wait for you to step into this adventure with us. Watch the trailer, feel the Easter magic, and join us in bringing joy to the world of THRAE!

Steam Next fest demo will be live soon! Stay posted!
